SELECT a.id AS id, a.name AS name, a.person_type AS personType, a.gender AS gender, -- 使用COALESCE函数，优先使用关联表数据，为空时使用swm_person表中保存的数据（需要翻译） COALESCE(o.office_name, backup_o.office_name) AS organization, COALESCE(p.position_name, backup_p.position_name) AS workShop, -- 🏭 车间字段 COALESCE(fpl.prod_line_name, backup_fpl.prod_line_name) AS prodLine, -- 🏗️ 产线字段 COALESCE(wg.work_group_name, backup_wg.work_group_name) AS teamGroup, -- 👥 班组字段 COALESCE(f.work_type, backup_wt.work_type) AS workType, -- 工种字段 a.safety_helmet_id AS safetyHelmetId, a.personnel_status AS personnelStatus, a.safety_education AS safetyEducation, a.identity_card AS identityCard, a.phone_number AS phoneNumber, a.helmet_returned AS helmetReturned, a.departure_type AS departureType, a.departure_reason AS departureReason, a.departure_date AS departureDate, a.create_by AS createBy, a.create_date AS createDate, a.update_by AS updateBy, a.update_date AS updateDate, a.remarks AS remarks, a.status AS status, -- 关联表的ID字段 2025/06/24 Shawn 添加 f.id AS workerArchiveId, -- 工人档案ID COALESCE(o.office_code, backup_o.office_code) AS officeCode, -- 组织编码 COALESCE(p.id, backup_p.id) AS positionArchiveId, -- 车间ID COALESCE(wg.id, backup_wg.id) AS workGroupId, -- 班组ID COALESCE(fpl.id, backup_fpl.id) AS prodLineId -- 产线ID FROM swm_person a -- 原有的关联查询（通过fms_worker关联） LEFT JOIN fms_worker f ON a.identity_card = f.identity_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN js_sys_office o ON f.office_code = o.office_code AND o.zip_code IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN fms_position_archive p ON f.work_shop_code = p.id AND p.type = 'CJ' LEFT JOIN fms_work_group wg ON f.work_group_id = wg.id LEFT JOIN fms_prod_line fpl ON fpl.id = wg.prod_line_id -- 备用关联查询（直接使用swm_person表中保存的ID进行翻译） LEFT JOIN js_sys_office backup_o ON a.company = backup_o.office_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND backup_o.zip_code IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN fms_position_archive backup_p ON a.department = backup_p.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND backup_p.type = 'CJ' LEFT JOIN fms_work_group backup_wg ON a.team = backup_wg.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN fms_prod_line backup_fpl ON a.prod_line = backup_fpl.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN swm_work_type backup_wt ON a.job_type = backup_wt.work_type_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci WHERE a.personnel_status = '1' and a.status = '0'
AND a.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchName}, '%')
AND ( -- 主关联查询条件（通过 fms_worker） p.id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{organizationKey}, '%') -- 🏭 车间ID查询 OR fpl.id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{organizationKey}, '%') -- 🏗️ 产线ID查询 OR wg.id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{organizationKey}, '%') -- 👥 班组ID查询 OR f.office_code = #{organizationKey} -- 🏢 厂间编码查询 OR f.id = #{organizationKey} -- 人员编码 -- 备用关联查询条件（直接使用 swm_person 表中的字段） OR backup_p.id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{organizationKey}, '%') -- 🏭 备用车间ID查询 OR backup_fpl.id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{organizationKey}, '%') -- 🏗️ 备用产线ID查询 OR backup_wg.id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{organizationKey}, '%') -- 👥 备用班组ID查询 OR backup_o.office_code = #{organizationKey} -- 🏢 备用厂间编码查询 -- swm_person 表中的直接字段查询 OR a.company = #{organizationKey} -- 公司ID直接查询 OR a.department = #{organizationKey} -- 部门ID直接查询 OR a.prod_line = #{organizationKey} -- 产线ID直接查询 OR a.team = #{organizationKey} -- 班组ID直接查询 OR a.job_type = #{organizationKey} -- 工种代码直接查询 OR backup_wt.work_type_code = #{organizationKey} -- 备用工种代码查询 )
LIMIT 50000

SELECT a.id AS id, a.name AS name, a.person_type AS personType, a.gender AS gender, o.office_name AS organization, p.position_name AS workShop, fpl.prod_line_name AS prodLine, wg.work_group_name AS teamGroup, f.work_type AS workType, a.identity_card AS identityCard, -- 关联表的ID字段 2025/06/24 Shawn 添加 f.id AS workerArchiveId, -- 工人档案ID o.office_code AS officeCode, -- 组织编码 p.id AS positionArchiveId, -- 车间ID wg.id AS workGroupId, -- 班组ID fpl.id AS prodLineId -- 产线ID FROM swm_person a LEFT JOIN fms_worker f ON a.identity_card = f.identity_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN js_sys_office o ON f.office_code = o.office_code AND o.zip_code IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN fms_position_archive p ON f.work_shop_code = p.id AND p.type = 'CJ' LEFT JOIN fms_work_group wg ON f.work_group_id = wg.id LEFT JOIN fms_prod_line fpl ON fpl.id = wg.prod_line_id WHERE a.identity_card = #{identityCard} AND a.personnel_status = '1' LIMIT 1
SELECT color FROM swm_helmet_subitem WHERE `key` = #{key} AND status = '0' ORDER BY create_date DESC LIMIT 1
